sources.snippet: 2.2 Socratic Chain-of-Thought Distillation (SCoT) Socratic Chain-of-Thought (SCoT) is a knowledge distillation technique that trains its student model on rationals elicited from the teacher model when solving a particular problem, training the student to simplify and solve complex problems in a similar step-by-step manner to the teacher.
